entities.summary: Lykourgos Angelopoulos was a Greek chanter. He was professor at the School of Byzantine Chant at the Conservatory of Athens, the founder and director of the Greek Byzantine Choir and an Archon Protopsaltes of the Patriarchate of Constantinople.
